referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. For rail infrastructure, expenditures and environmental interventions due to construction, renewal and disposal of rail tracks have been allocated based on the Gross tonne kilometre performance on SBB track in 2014 (72126484166 Gtkm). Expenditures due to operation of the rail infrastructure, as well as land use have been allocated based on the yearly train kilometre performance (398215 vkm) and a load factor of 193 passengers. Electricity and diesel consumption have been updated based on SBB data for the year 2019.; UUID: 9bdf6416-f2e1-3d5d-a7f3-516962fb0c6a
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the modules "production, maintenance and disposal of vehicles" as well as the modules "construction, maintenance and disposal of railway tracks". Included in this modul is the operation (energy consumption including shunting and emissions) of the train .
referenceFunction.name: Transport, long-distance train, SBB mix

technology.text: For vehicle operation all technologies are included in the average data. Rail construction addresses conventional gravel track beddings. For the manufacturing of vehicles, the data reflects the currently dominating train type (IC2000).

representativeness.extrapolations: Some generic datasets from ecoinvent have been used.
